source.constructor: new independently seeded layered branching automata with an alternate invalid noisy target branch; not previous-source calls

architecture.hypothesis: Learn the relationship between TWO public noisy edge transitions from examples, without giving the model a mismatching-bit index, equality comparator, or label-dependent operator.
architecture.inputs: Raw (previous carried 16 bits, next public src 16 bits) for first event and second event, grouped only by the existing 16 aligned bit lanes; shared raw 4-bit per-lane neural operator with 8 tanh units and mean pooling; 4x8 weights, 8 biases, 8 output weights, 1 output bias =49 learned floats.
architecture.trainable_features: Raw bit-lane tuple frequencies; no supplied Hamming position index, equality target operator, XOR fingerprint, hand-coded collision-free identity or source family during learned classification.
architecture.fixed_inductive_bias: Public role matching, exactly two one-bit noisy events gate, paired lane alignment, source raw carried pair packed in existing cell.score 33-bit integer, deterministic public destination-diversity fixed rank and 7+9 cell selection. These are engineered; do not claim the full operator system is learned.

state.score_payload: packed 33-bit first raw transition pair or -1 completed; larger Python scalar bytes must be measured and not misreported memory-matched

training.update: deterministic supervised SGD on 288 FIT labelled positive/negative public graph paths; labels only for training
training.selection: maximum FIT paired correctness with exactly zero FIT FP and at least 72/144 positive recalls, no candidate -> unqualified diagnostic at frozen min threshold; no model or threshold tuning on DEV

comparators.original_O_U: original authenticated FIT-trained O and U and frozen combined
comparators.fixed_consistency16: source-independent deterministic two-error bit-index equality from predecessor
comparators.fixed_collisionfree: hand-coded scalar identity policy from F124-AI
comparators.trained_raw_neural: FIT-trained raw neural + FIT-selected threshold; report failed positive sensitivity and FP without hiding negatives
